# Case study index

13 public case studies. Detail files are in `references/case-studies/<slug>.md`. Numbers are the site's own headline metrics; when a study lists none, its first outcomes are shown instead.

## Memori (memori)

- Title: Memori: Open-Source Launch to 12,000+ GitHub Stars
- Services: Community-led Launches, Thought Leadership, Demo Content, Live Events, Influencer Management
- Numbers: 12,000+ GitHub stars, grown from 0; 50K+ impressions on the Reddit launch post; 12 hands-on demo agents shipped
- What was done: Community-led launch support, hands-on demo agents, and developer feedback helped an early OSS project grow to 12,000+ GitHub stars.
- Detail: `references/case-studies/memori.md`
